title: chart.line
description: Line chart of one or more series over a numeric x, with direct series labels, a transient highlight, vertical annotations, an optional interval band, point markers and a forecast segment. Changing `y` morphs the lines with a keyed join.

data.description: Path to a CSV file, relative to the deck root. One row per series and x value.

x.description: Column holding the numeric x value.

y.description: Column holding the numeric y value. Changing it morphs each line point by point (keyed by series and x) while the y axis rescales.

series.description: Column naming the series of each row. Omit for a single line (its key is 'all'). Series take palette colors in order of first appearance in the data.

series_shown.description: Series to draw, by name. Omit to draw every series. A series that appears is drawn along its length; one that leaves fades out.

highlight.description: Series to emphasize; every other series turns the theme's dim color. Usually set with `only` so it lasts one step.

x.description: x value of the vertical rule.

label.description: Short label next to the rule.

annotate.description: Vertical rules with a label at given x values.

x.description: x axis title, shown under the axis.

y.description: y axis title, shown above the plot.

x.description: d3-format spec for x tick labels.

y.description: d3-format spec for y tick labels.

format.description: Tick label formats (d3-format, localized by the deck language). Default: fixed precision from the tick step.

types.description: CSV column types, passed to the data loader. Undeclared columns are numbers only when every value looks like one.

interval.description: Shaded band between two columns around each series (e.g. an uncertainty interval). Morphs with the lines.

points.description: Draw a dot at every data point of every shown series. Dots after `forecast.from` are hollow. Fades in and out.

from.description: x value where the forecast starts. The line from here on is dotted, its points hollow, its band lighter, and the plot from here to its end is shaded and labelled. Before the first x the whole line is forecast; after the last x there is no forecast part.

label.description: Text of the label at the divider. Default: the deck language's word for 'Forecast'.

forecast.description: Marks the part of every line from an x value on as a forecast: a dotted line with hollow points, a lighter band, a shaded region and a labelled divider. The observed line ends exactly where the dotted one starts. Fades in and out.
